Choose one joint finite admission ledger which accounts for early reservations plus remaining work, API/read/write/flush/close counts, source loading and finalization. interfaces.minimum_successor_requirement: One canonical lifecycle-finalizer owns all closer reservations. Bootstrap/continuation views delegate and never duplicate close dispatch even on false/unreturned close, wrapper fault, KI/SE or repeated cleanup request. Required sources stay live until final execution ends. Preserve original primary identity, later cleanup/publication errors, known byte counts and retained buffers. At hard cutoff retain in-memory failure evidence without invoking any further output I/O; final acknowledgment/clock must refer to this same sink and Origin.
